_doc: Spellcasting sold by name (#55). Edited by hand. tools/build_spell_goods.py sells every SRD 5.2 spell with a costed material component by name, with the component in the price, unless it is listed under not_sold, and stops if a listed spell has no costed component. A spell is sold by name only if it works without the caster: a buyer walks out of the shop with it. The ones listed here stay available through the level services, with their components added.
